item.title: Bentonville Daily — August 9, 2026
item.description:
A heat advisory covering Benton County takes effect Sunday at noon, with heat index values expected to reach 108 degrees.
Heat advisory issued for Sunday in Benton County. The National Weather Service has issued a heat advisory for Benton County from noon to 8 p.m. Sunday, with heat index values expected to reach 108 degrees.
Bentonville Combined Committee of the Whole and City Council meets August 11. The council is set to consider several zoning changes, a public right-of-way vacation, and two grants for parks and traffic technology. Agendas for the other meetings this period are published too.
Bentonville Finance Committee to meet monday. The Bentonville Finance Committee meets Monday at 5 p.m., followed by a combined Committee of the Whole and City Council meeting at 6 p.m.
Taziki's opens Rogers location. Taziki's Mediterranean Café opened at 1771 W. Pleasant Grove Road, Suite 104, in Rogers. The approximately 2,900-square-foot restaurant seats 85 guests and required a $950,000 investment.
Simmons Foods promotes Scott Salmon to chief commercial officer. Siloam Springs-based Simmons Foods promoted Scott Salmon, president of Simmons Pet Food, to the newly created role of chief commercial officer. Jacob Rogers will succeed Salmon in his previous position.
Walton Family Foundation grants $599,139 to NWACC. The Walton Family Foundation provided a $599,139 grant to Northwest Arkansas Community College to expand its Learning, Improvement, Fun and Empowerment program.
Jessica DeBari named executive director of Community Creative Center. Fayetteville artist Jessica DeBari has been appointed executive director of Community Creative Center, a Fayetteville-based nonprofit arts organization. She replaces Bryce Brisco, who stepped down in late July.
Tyson Foods board declares quarterly dividend. The board of directors of Tyson Foods Inc. declared a quarterly dividend payment of 51 cents per share for Class A shareholders, payable on December 15.
Downtown Springdale Alliance hosts free picnic in the park series. Throughout August, the Downtown Springdale Alliance is hosting weekly Saturday events featuring food, music, and community gathering.
Terra Studios hosts Paws, Paint, & Play event in September. Terra Studios will host its fourth annual Paws, Paint, & Play event, a canine-friendly art park experience, on Sunday, September 6 from noon to 4 p.m.
Benton County named as candidate for possible nuclear development. Arkansas lawmakers received results of a study on the feasibility of adding nuclear power to the state, which named a site in Northwest Arkansas as a candidate for possible future development.
Benton County holds meeting on one-cent sales tax. Benton County held an intergovernment meeting to discuss a proposed one-cent sales tax.
Two River Valley counties under burn ban during moderate wildfire risk. Amid high temperatures and limited rain, some Northwest Arkansas and River Valley counties are under burn bans due to moderate wildfire risk.
